actions.description: Hand removes a pipette with an attached tip from the rack/holder and moves it toward the bench.
Pipette tip is inserted into a yellow tip box/open rack area; no liquid container is clearly visible, so aspiration/dispense cannot be confirmed.
Pipette is withdrawn from the rack/box area and moved upward.
Pipette is returned to the rack/holder with the tip still attached.
Pipettes remain hanging; hand reaches back toward the same pipette.

reuse.evidence: No visible use of the same tip across different samples/reagents; no clear aspiration or dispense into different media is shown.

surface.evidence: The tip is not visibly touching a bench, glove, hand, tube exterior, or other non-sterile surface before use.

release.evidence: No tip is dropped/ejected unexpectedly; the pipette remains controlled and the tip stays attached.

install.evidence: Tip appears seated on the pipette and appropriately sized; no visible poor fit or wrong-size tip.

output.overall_summary: A pipette with an attached tip is removed from the holder, placed into/near a tip box or rack, then returned to the holder. No clear technique error is visible.
